title: Repairing the Orchard Pump
paras: Lila's first task with the valley's repair crew was to inspect a wooden pump supplying hillside orchards. Its painted flowers reflected earlier owners' [[esthetic|esthetic]] preferences. With [[desertification|desertification]] threatening nearby farmland, however, the crew prioritised its working parts.

Before they could [[embark|embark]] on repairs, they had to remove the ceramic cups attached to its chain. Pale deposits of [[inorganic|inorganic]] salts lined their interiors. Lila tested each cleaned cup against one essential [[criterion|criterion]]: could it retain water throughout the ascent? Any cup that leaked was rejected, however attractive its shape. She measured the fittings so replacements would fit the existing chain.

The repair ledger also contained older accounts of disputes. After the military [[conquest|conquest]] of the valley, access to the main canal had been restricted. [[rivalry|Rivalry]] between orchard owners initially prevented joint repairs. Later entries recorded households sharing timber, rope and labour. To Lila, this suggested growing [[cohesion|cohesion]], though the entries alone could not explain why attitudes had changed. Her grandmother remembered lengthy negotiations over each family's contribution.

The pump restarted with a sudden clatter that seemed to [[daze|daze]] Lila for a moment. She stepped back while the foreman checked the chain. Her father, watching from the path, recalled giving her a [[piggyback|piggyback]] up that same hill. This time she walked home carrying a cracked cup to show the potter.
zh: 莉拉加入山谷维修队后的第一项任务，是检查一台为山坡果园供水的木制水泵。泵上彩绘的花朵体现了先前所有者的审美偏好。不过，附近农田正受到荒漠化威胁，因此维修队优先关注水泵的运转部件。
开始维修前，他们必须卸下连接在链条上的陶杯。杯内壁附着着浅色的无机盐沉积物。莉拉按一项必要标准测试每只洗净的杯子：它能否在整个上升过程中盛住水？任何漏水的杯子都会被弃用，无论外形多么美观。她测量了连接部件，以确保替换杯能适配现有链条。
维修账簿中还记载着早年的纠纷。山谷遭武力征服后，主灌渠的使用受到限制。果园主之间的竞争最初使共同维修无法开展。后来的条目记载了各户共同提供木材、绳索和劳力。在莉拉看来，这表明凝聚力在增强，不过，仅凭这些条目还无法解释态度为何发生变化。她的祖母或外祖母记得，大家曾就每家应承担的份额进行漫长的协商。
水泵重新启动，突然发出一阵哐当声，似乎让莉拉一时有些发懵。工头检查链条时，她退后了几步。父亲站在小路上观看，回忆起自己曾背着她爬上同一座山坡。这一次，她步行回家，手里拿着一只裂杯，要给陶工看。

q.s: The pump's flowers were painted by a local potter.
q.why: 文中未交代彩绘花朵出自谁手。

q.s: Lila accepted leaking cups if their shapes were attractive.
q.why: 所有漏水杯都被弃用，不论外形如何。

q.s: Later ledger entries recorded households sharing repair resources.
q.why: 后期条目记载各户共同提供木材、绳索和劳力。
